name: Job Ready: Workplace & Interview Skills
description: For everyone and graduating learners: resumes, interviews, teamwork, and professional habits that help you get and keep a job.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of a resume?
options: To list every job ever done
To summarize your skills and experience for employers
questions.explanation: A resume markets your relevant skills and experience concisely.

questions.prompt: In an interview, "Tell me about yourself" is best answered by...
options: A short summary of your background, skills, and goals
questions.explanation: Keep it brief, relevant, and focused on the role.

questions.prompt: Which is the most professional email address?
questions.explanation: A name-based address looks professional to employers.

questions.prompt: What should you do before a job interview?
options: Arrive exactly at start time without research
Research the company and practice answers
questions.explanation: Preparation shows genuine interest in the company.

questions.prompt: Which is an example of a soft skill?
questions.explanation: Soft skills are interpersonal abilities like communication.

questions.prompt: If you will be late to work because of an emergency, you should...
options: Inform your supervisor as soon as possible
Ask a coworker to lie for you
questions.explanation: Prompt, honest communication is professional behavior.

options: The latest time a task must be finished
questions.explanation: A deadline is the due date and time for a task.

options: Doing only your own tasks and ignoring others
Helping a struggling teammate meet a shared goal
Repeat the resume word for word
Explain why you fit this specific job
questions.explanation: A cover letter connects your experience to the specific role.

questions.prompt: During an interview, good body language includes...
options: Sitting upright and making comfortable eye contact
questions.explanation: Upright posture and eye contact show confidence and respect.

questions.prompt: What is the best way to handle constructive criticism?
options: Listen, ask clarifying questions, and improve

questions.prompt: Which document proves your identity for employment in the Philippines?

options: Building professional relationships that share opportunities

questions.prompt: If you do not know the answer to an interview question, you should...
options: Be honest and explain how you would find out

questions.prompt: What is a professional way to follow up after an interview?
options: Complain if there is no reply in a day
questions.explanation: One courteous thank-you message leaves a good impression.
